entities.name: Krzysztof Śmiszek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Krzysztof Jan Śmiszek is a Polish lawyer, politician, human rights and minority rights activist, and Doctor of Legal Sciences. He is a co-founder and former chair of the Polish Society of Anti-Discrimination Law, a member of the Sejm 9th and 10th terms (2019–2024), vice-chair of the New Left, Deputy Minister of Justice from 2023 to 2024, and a Member of the European Parliament for the 10th term.
